title: Qwen3.8-27B: Alibaba Releases Open Weights for New Multimodal AI Model
summary: Alibaba has released the open weights for Qwen3.8-27B, a multimodal dense AI model with 27 billion parameters. The model outperforms its predecessor, Qwen3.7-Plus, particularly in coding and office workflows. Key features include a native context length of 262K tokens (extendable to 1M via YaRN), high efficiency, and Apache 2.0 licensing. The release also includes Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B for advanced use cases. Both models are available for download on Hugging Face and ModelScope.
key_points: Qwen3.8-27B is a multimodal dense model with 27B parameters, outperforming Qwen3.7-Plus in real-world applications like coding and office workflows.
Features a native context length of 262K tokens, extendable to 1M tokens using YaRN.
Licensed under Apache 2.0, making it highly accessible for builders and developers.
Alibaba also released Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, a larger model for advanced use cases.
Both models are available for download on Hugging Face and ModelScope.
